Strategy: Exact-fit bonus only: add a large bonus only when a bin's residual equals the item exactly, otherwise score by tightest fit; this closes bins perfectly whenever possible instead of leaving a small unusable sliver, while behaving like Best Fit in all other states. It can fail when exact fits are rare, making it nearly identical to Best Fit with no gain.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (1000.0 if r == item else 0.0)) for r in bins]
```
